nodes.norm_label: note block visibility (gm, players, listed, owner)
nodes.rationale: listed with empty audience fails closed to GM only; owner blocks are hidden even from GM and admin.

nodes.label: Package Layout (cmd, config, db, auth, perm, hub, dnd5e, compendium, export, join, web)
nodes.norm_label: package layout (cmd, config, db, auth, perm, hub, dnd5e, compendium, export, join, web)

nodes.norm_label: session tokens (32 bytes, sha-256 hash, secure cookie)

nodes.label: Stack: Go, gin, templ, shadcn-templ, htmx, go:embed
nodes.norm_label: stack: go, gin, templ, shadcn-templ, htmx, go:embed

nodes.label: UI Conventions (shadcn-templ, localTime, aria-pressed, busy, checkVisibility)
nodes.norm_label: ui conventions (shadcn-templ, localtime, aria-pressed, busy, checkvisibility)

nodes.label: First visit on each device (certificate warning)
nodes.norm_label: first visit on each device (certificate warning)

nodes.label: Commands, Not Saved Sheets (delta commands)
nodes.rationale: Several devices may hold one character, so clients send deltas applied transactionally rather than whole-object overwrites.

nodes.label: Compendium Normalization and Attribution
nodes.rationale: Never leak source shape into the app; keep license and attribution (2024 SRD CC-BY 4.0).

nodes.label: Minimal Websocket JSON Patches and Refetch Orders
nodes.norm_label: minimal websocket json patches and refetch orders
nodes.rationale: Send only changed values as JSON bound via data-bind; wholesale changes trigger refetch from /live over HTTP; never HTML over websocket.

nodes.label: No node or npm; vendored JS via cmd/vendorjs
nodes.norm_label: no node or npm; vendored js via cmd/vendorjs
nodes.rationale: Everything ships in one Go binary via go:embed; browser libs are downloaded pinned and embedded.

nodes.label: Out of Scope Features
nodes.rationale: LAN-only tool for friends at a table: no accounts, internet hosting, Docker, remote play, dice rolling, offline mode; ask before adding.

nodes.label: Visibility Enforced on Server
nodes.rationale: Hidden data never reaches the browser; unrevealed entity fields stripped including keys; GM/admin never get owner note blocks.
